description: Deliver the Workflow-direct mohist/pi path end to end: pin and verify the bundled Pi SDK, implement the in-process PiRuntime, make Workflow AgentSession coordination and binding runtime-aware without breaking OpenCode, durably report Session facts, and expose Pi-backed Session milestones without adding AgentJob, Session-command, or model-catalog UI scope.

tasks.title: Pin Pi SDK and verify the runtime/toolchain contract
tasks.description: Pin @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to an exact Runner dependency, raise every documented and enforced Node floor to 22.19, and make CI and Docker use a compatible concrete release. Run the real-SDK smoke before product implementation, record the verified service, Session, prompt, event, trust, model, and interruption surfaces, and reconcile upstream drift into the canonical runtime call map.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/runner/package.json pins @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to an exact version, package-lock.json is updated through the Runner workspace npm command, and no ACP/RPC adapter dependency is added

The root and Runner package manifests require Node >=22.19; CONTRIBUTING.md advertises the same prerequisite; CI and the Docker builder install an explicit compatible Node release rather than an unspecified Node 22 minor

openspec/changes/issue-450/sdk-smoke-verification.json records only pinned package/Node versions, operation names, pass/fail booleans, and sanitized field-name/type summaries for ModelRuntime/catalog, project-untrusted resources, SessionManager create/open, sessionFile identity, createAgentSession, literal Prompt completion, messages/events, model/thinking selection, steer, abort, and stop confirmation
The smoke proves repository-local .pi settings/extensions/packages/skills/prompts are not loaded while global Pi configuration and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md context remain available

The smoke identifies stable message/tool/usage/retry identities, the final Session message surfaces usable for restart reconciliation, and the option that disables prompt-template expansion without recording environment/auth values, provider responses, Prompt/message bodies, or raw SDK objects
A secret scan of the smoke artifact and staged change passes before commit; a sentinel credential used by the smoke wrapper is absent from the artifact even on a failed operation
Any SDK drift found by the smoke is reflected in design/runtimes/pi.md and openspec/changes/issue-450/design.md before T-002 starts
A clean npm ci succeeds on Node >=22.19, and npm run typecheck -w packages/runner passes with the pinned dependency
tasks.output: Pinned Pi SDK and Node toolchain updates in package manifests, lockfile, CONTRIBUTING.md, CI, and Docker, plus sdk-smoke-verification.json and any required call-map reconciliation
tasks.notes: Hard gate for Pi SDK implementation. The smoke uses real Pi and may require configured provider credentials; if the environment cannot verify the required surface, record the blocker and do not implement T-002 from assumptions. Do not add product code, AgentJob routing, Session commands, or Pi catalog reporting here.

tasks.title: Implement the in-process PiRuntime deep module
tasks.description: Create packages/runner/src/runtime/pi as a complete deep module with Mohist-owned boundary types, injectable SDK services, project-untrusted resource setup, credential confinement/redaction, readiness/catalog state, physical Session create/open/cache/dispose, literal Prompt execution, per-turn model/thinking selection, event projection/reconciliation, deadline/cancellation/provider interruption, execution quarantine, provider policy, and normalized errors. Parse Runner provider policy once and supply the same pure object to OpenCode and Pi without introducing a generic AgentRuntime interface.
acceptanceCriteria: All @earendil-works/pi SDK imports are confined to packages/runner/src/runtime/pi, and callers/tests consume only Mohist-owned Pi request/result/diagnostic types

start()/ready()/diagnostic() become ready only after SDK services initialize and getAvailable completes; an empty catalog is ready with a warning, while initialization/catalog failure stays not-ready with an actionable diagnostic and retryable start path

cli.ts parses MOHIST_PROVIDER_RETRY_THRESHOLD as a positive integer defaulting to 5 and MOHIST_PROVIDER_NON_RECOVERABLE_TERMS as a JSON array of non-empty literal strings; invalid values block Pi readiness and operator text is escaped rather than evaluated as regular expressions

Runner startup configuration carries one parsed provider policy object; OpenCode consumes that object and PiRuntime accepts the same object, with tests proving non-default threshold/literal terms reach both runtime boundaries and preserve existing OpenCode defaults

The SDK factory fixes project trust to false, gives global authentication only to Pi's auth manager, loads repository instruction files, and supplies no repository-local .pi execution resources; Mohist-owned boundary types contain no credential fields or raw SDK objects

createSession returns the normalized absolute session-file path and rejects a missing path as incompatible-runtime; restoring uses SessionManager.open and a missing/corrupt file returns missing-session without implicit creation

runTurn applies model and thinking level on the existing Session, preserves the complete model remainder after the first slash, submits slash-prefixed Prompts literally, awaits prompt() as the only completion authority, reads final assistant text from messages, and never issues a second wait or replays an uncertain Prompt

The event projector maps assistant/reasoning/tool/model/usage facts, persists smoke-verified message/tool/usage fingerprints through its caller-owned state, reconciles final messages, and treats unknown events as diagnostics only

Fake-timer tests cover the 60-minute default, declared deadline, one wrap-up warning, short-deadline warning-at-start, deadline result fixation, external cancellation result fixation, late completion, confirmed abort, and no replay

An unconfirmed timeout, cancellation, or provider-triggered abort quarantines the physical Session path and emits the signal used to quarantine its logical coordinator key; provider failure remains turn-failed with interruption-unconfirmed diagnostic, other paths remain available, observed stop clears runtime quarantine, and Runner restart starts with no in-process execution quarantine

Provider-policy tests cover first-event quota/credit/billing failure, recoverable retries below the configured threshold, threshold-N failure, Pi-native terminal error normalization, confirmed and unconfirmed provider abort, logical/physical quarantine signal, and binding preservation

Credential tests inject sentinel environment/auth/provider values and prove they are absent from Pi requests/results, diagnostics, task-log output, registration/event/outbox shapes, and Action-visible facts while surfaced text contains the existing CredentialMasker placeholder
Runtime tests use fake SDK services, virtual paths, and fake timers only; npm run typecheck -w packages/runner and npm test -w packages/runner pass
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/runtime/pi deep module, validated shared provider-policy configuration, and deterministic fake-SDK runtime tests
tasks.notes: Implements design D1, the Pi-runtime half of D3, D7, and the projector half of D8. It does not register mohist/pi, alter Workflow Session routes, implement AgentJob Pi execution, or add Session commands.

tasks.title: Make Workflow Session coordination and binding runtime-aware
tasks.description: Introduce the shared WorkflowSessionTurnCoordinator used by every Workflow Inline Agent task lifecycle, make only Workflow open/bind and a new Action-owned event route runtime-aware, and add the AgentSession Action cursor plus atomic drained-stream seal/rebind transition. Migrate the existing mohist/opencode caller atomically while leaving current Workflow Follow-up and generic event DTO/routes unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowSessionTurnCoordinator serializes by projectId/WorkflowRunId/sessionName from before open through Action execution, successful completion checks, any worktree cleanup turn, and final reporter persistence; it removes settled task tails, supports logical quarantine, and allows different keys to run independently

mohist/opencode enters the shared coordinator for its complete task lifecycle; concurrent OpenCode/OpenCode and OpenCode/Pi test operations on one key cannot overlap, queued same-name work cannot intervene between a turn and cleanup, and different keys can

Workflow Session open requires runtime opencode or pi, returns observed runtime/binding/workDir/Runner/event cursor, and the existing OpenCode caller sends runtime opencode atomically with the Server contract change
Workflow bind carries target runtime, expected current runtime/session, and for rebind the current owning Runner plus drainedThroughSequence; first bind and repeated same bind remain idempotent

A guarded cross-runtime rebind in either direction preserves logical identity/workDir, appends one lineage entry, and succeeds only when expected binding/Runner match and the current Server cursor equals drainedThroughSequence

The successful rebind seals the old stream and installs the new binding in one AgentSession transition; mismatch, gap, stale expectation, another Runner's attestation, or same-runtime different physical ID rejects without either mutation

A dedicated Workflow Action runtime-event DTO/route carries deterministic stream identity and sequence; the existing AgentSessionRuntimeEventsRequest plus Workflow Follow-up/failure-outbox and generic routes remain wire-compatible and unsequenced

The Action-event transition acknowledges sequence <= cursor without reapplying, accepts only cursor + 1, and rejects gaps, sealed streams, and stale physical bindings before transcript/usage/model mutation; existing Session-command events remain binding-validated outside the Action cursor
The authoritative workDir remains immutable and mismatch rejects before binding mutation; Pi is registered while historical runtime fallback and generic AgentJob DTO/routes remain unchanged

Server and Runner coverage includes existing OpenCode and Workflow Follow-up/failure-outbox regression paths, Action-versus-command DTO routing, first/idempotent bind, symmetric lineage, expected-binding races, atomic seal failure/success, duplicate/gap/sealed/stale Action events, workspace mismatch, Pi registration, persistence/reactivation, and coordinator cleanup concurrency

Coordinator identity tests prove identical session names remain isolated across different projects and WorkflowRuns as well as different names, while Session Action events including final/end facts never mutate TaskRun status or advance Workflow
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, npm test -w packages/runner, and npm test pass with deterministic fakes only
tasks.output: Shared Workflow Session turn coordinator, atomically migrated OpenCode Workflow caller/wire, guarded runtime binding, and idempotent Server event cursor/seal
tasks.notes: Independent of the Pi SDK and deliverable as an OpenCode-preserving Session infrastructure change. Split the new Action event route instead of changing existing Follow-up/generic DTOs. Do not route public Follow-up/Compact/Reset/Cancel commands to Pi or let one Runner attest another Runner's local Action stream.

tasks.title: Implement the durable Workflow Session event outbox
tasks.description: Implement WorkflowSessionEventOutbox as the runtime-neutral owner of Workflow Action stream manifests, encoding, fingerprints, sequencing, acknowledgement compaction, reporting quarantine, and restart repair over injected byte storage. Add a separately testable atomic-replace protocol over low-level file operations, the thin production adapter, host startup/background drain, Pi reconciliation hooks, and fenced prepareRebind using T-003's Action cursor/seal protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowSessionOutboxStorage exposes list/read/replaceAtomically/remove byte operations; AtomicSnapshotReplaceProtocol owns write -> file sync -> same-directory rename -> directory sync -> cleanup ordering over injected low-level operations, while the production adapter only supplies Node filesystem operations

The real outbox codec/state machine runs over injected storage and deterministically identifies one stream by logical AgentSession plus physical binding; tests use in-memory bytes and never instantiate or access the host filesystem

Every OpenCode and Pi Workflow binding creates the same stream manifest and uses it for session.input, required admission drain, and rebind fencing; OpenCode can drain and seal an empty-or-input-only stream without connecting its full runtime-event observer

Before Prompt admission the outbox atomically creates a manifest containing binding identity, physical repair target when available, next sequence, projector fingerprints, and active-turn checkpoint; session.input is Server-acknowledged and the checkpoint is durably marked admitted before the Runtime call

Each required canonical Pi audit fact and updated projector fingerprint is one atomic snapshot replacement; final checkpoint closure occurs only after final assistant/reasoning, completed tool/result, model, and input/output/cache-read/cache-write/thought usage facts supplied by Pi are durable, and delivery occurs in monotonic sequence order

Ambiguous acknowledgement retries the same sequence, duplicate acknowledgement compacts once, and a Server gap retains/resends the missing prefix; post-turn transport failure preserves the completed Action result when records are durable and background/startup drain retries without Prompt replay

prepareRebind holds the stream fence, drains every locally issued sequence, and supplies the final sequence to T-003's atomic seal-and-bind call; failure returns session-reporting-failed and admits neither a Prompt nor rebind

A post-admission local append failure fixes session-reporting-failed, interrupts an active Pi turn, quarantines that physical Session from later Prompt/rebind admission, retains the fact in memory, and does not replay the Prompt

Startup closes prepared-but-not-admitted checkpoints without Runtime replay; for admitted Pi checkpoints it opens the persisted Session through an injected repair hook, reconciles required final facts using persisted fingerprints, and clears reporting quarantine only after repair; an absent/unreadable Pi file records uncertain submission and leaves runtime-session-missing with Reset guidance without replacement or replay

A corrupt committed manifest is preserved and quarantines only its logical Session while unrelated Sessions and AgentJob work remain available; root/list/atomic-capability initialization failure makes the outbox globally not-ready and gates Runner registration/claiming

Atomic protocol tests over fake operations cover every write/sync/rename/directory-sync failure and classify rename-success/directory-sync-failure as commit-uncertain; fixed virtual paths assert same-directory rename and supported filesystem assumptions without instantiating the physical adapter

Codec/state-machine tests cover OpenCode -> Pi -> OpenCode Action stream creation/drain/seal, atomic old-or-new generations, append failure before/after admission, per-stream corruption, global storage readiness failure, duplicate/gap recovery, restart reconciliation/drain, pre-admission/pre-rebind failure, all usage dimensions, and no replay
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, npm test -w packages/runner, and npm test pass
tasks.output: Crash-consistent Workflow Session outbox, injected byte storage and production file adapter, host drain/repair, reporting quarantine, and deterministic recovery tests
tasks.notes: Implements D8's transport and local-persistence guarantees before the Pi Action consumes them. The outbox owns its format and recovery policy; the physical adapter owns only byte persistence. Never turn event-delivery or append failure into automatic Prompt replay.

tasks.title: Recognize Pi as a Workflow Inline Agent Action
tasks.description: Update Server Workflow validation, classification, translation, serialization, and parent-context selection to use the architecture-specified explicit Inline Agent Action set containing mohist/opencode and mohist/pi. Keep the change at the dispatch/presentation boundary so runtime implementation, AgentJob routing, and Session commands remain untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: Server static validation accepts uses=mohist/pi with prompt/session/options and rejects legacy with.agent, with.kind, and with.type before dispatch with an Action-specific message
TaskRun.DeriveClassification, WorkflowItemTranslator, and WorkflowYamlSerializer classify mohist/pi as UserFacing Inline Agent without substring matching or changing non-inline Actions

Plan-stage parent issue context is attached for mohist/opencode and mohist/pi only under the existing task/stage/parent guards defined in design/workflow/task-dispatch.md; checks, other stages, AgentJobs, and unrelated Actions remain excluded
Validation and dispatch diagnostics refer to the selected Action rather than hard-coding OpenCode
Server specs cover accepted Pi dispatch, every legacy field rejection, both Inline Agent classifications, serialization, parent-context inclusion/exclusion guards, and unchanged OpenCode behavior
npm test passes
tasks.output: Pi-aware Server Workflow validation, explicit Inline Agent classification, parent-context dispatch, and regression specs
tasks.notes: The authoritative parent-context design has already been updated during planning. Do not register the Runner Action, add Pi AgentJob routing, or change model catalog APIs in this task.

tasks.title: Deliver the mohist/pi Workflow execution path
tasks.description: Integrate PiRuntime and the durable reporter into RunnerHost and WorkExecutor, register the standalone mohist/pi Action, and connect it to the shared logical-Session coordinator, guarded binding, Workflow completion/promise projection, recovery, and cleanup reuse. This is the final Runner vertical slice; it consumes the already-tested runtime, Session wire, outbox, and Server dispatch boundaries without touching AgentJob or Session-command routing.
acceptanceCriteria: RunnerHost creates one provider policy and credential masker, supplies them to OpenCode/Pi, initializes global outbox readiness plus both runtimes before Server registration, shuts them down together, periodically retries failed Pi/storage startup, and gates registration/new polling while still draining awaitingAck; Pi catalog data is not added to RunnerRegistration

ActionContext/baseContext/check/cleanup paths carry piRuntime and WorkflowSessionTurnCoordinator, createDefaultRegistry resolves mohist/pi, and ownerKind=agent-job continues to branch before Action resolution into OpenCode AgentJobExecutor

mohist/pi recursively consumes only expanded prompt/session/options; omitted or null session uses Work ID, explicit strings are trimmed, whitespace/non-string session fails before Session creation, options must be an object, model/variant accept only string or null, model requires a non-empty first-slash provider/model split, and unknown keys are diagnostic only
The Action has no hidden vars.agent fallback, Server-rejected legacy fields never execute, and slash-prefixed resolved Prompt text reaches Pi literally

A first turn enters the shared coordinator, rejects workDir mismatch, creates Pi, persists the guarded binding, creates its stream manifest, obtains session.input acknowledgement, marks the turn admitted, and only then calls prompt()

Same-name tasks, retries, cleanup, and Runner restart reuse one logical and physical Pi Session; model/variant changes preserve path and lineage; different logical names run independently; missing/corrupt bound Pi files fail with Reset guidance without replacement

The reporter durably projects required final assistant/reasoning, completed tool/result, model, and usage facts and closes the turn checkpoint before Action return; post-turn transport failure drains later without flipping success, while local append failure or a required pre-admission/pre-rebind drain failure maps to session-reporting-failed and blocks that attempted Prompt/rebind

Successful final assistant text reaches expect, failIf, artifact, recovery, and promise evaluation only through private turnFact; Action failure bypasses files/markers/missing-promise checks; public output is null or exactly {promise} and contains no runtime facts

All stable error mappings are covered: unavailable-runtime -> runtime-unavailable, missing-session -> runtime-session-missing, deadline-exceeded -> timeout, plus invalid-input, session-workspace-mismatch, session-binding-failed, session-reporting-failed, incompatible-runtime, interrupted, and turn-failed; binding failure submits no Prompt

Deadline maps to timeout, external cancellation maps to interrupted, provider exhaustion remains turn-failed even when abort is unconfirmed, and reporting failure maps to session-reporting-failed; every unconfirmed interruption quarantines the logical key before release
Worktree enforcement reinvokes the already-resolved mohist/pi Action under the original task lease on the same physical Session; a queued same-name task cannot run or rebind between work and cleanup

Fake-timer RunnerHost specs cover pre-registration Pi/storage readiness, empty-catalog warning, periodic retry, registration/poll suppression, recovery, unrelated per-stream corruption remaining available, and continued awaitingAck drain

Fake-backed Workflow specs cover open -> bind -> manifest/input acknowledgement -> Prompt/events -> final text -> expect/promise, exact input and every error mapping, same-session/cross-runtime serialization, cleanup intervention exclusion, project/WorkflowRun/name isolation, runtime-switch rejection during unconfirmed stop, retry/restart recovery, missing-file/bind failure, all usage dimensions, event non-completion, timeout/cancellation/provider/reporting failure, credential sentinel absence, and no replay
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, npm test -w packages/runner, and npm test pass
tasks.output: End-to-end Workflow-direct mohist/pi implementation across Runner host, Action, completion, Session binding/reporting, recovery, and cleanup with fake-backed Workflow coverage
tasks.notes: Consumes all preceding boundaries. The temporary runtime-bearing ActionContext and name-based promise/cleanup extension is explicitly owned for removal by issue #447; do not invent a competing capability abstraction. Keep Pi AgentJob execution, Follow-up/Compact/Reset/Cancel handlers, runtime-aware catalog reporting/UI, ACP/RPC, and a generic AgentRuntime out of scope.

tasks.title: Expose Pi Workflow Session presentation and close implementation gaps
tasks.description: Teach the Web Workflow milestone classifier to recognise mohist/pi and verify that existing runtime-neutral Session transcript, tools, model observations, usage, and lineage render Pi facts correctly. After the user-visible path is verified, update only implementation-gap footnotes in the Pi product/runtime documents to describe the delivered Workflow-direct path and retain explicit sister-issue gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: Web isInlineAgentTask recognises mohist/pi with a non-empty Session name and continues to exclude non-inline Actions and AgentJob work

A Pi Workflow Session fixture renders assistant text, tool lifecycle, resolved model, every supplied input/output/cache-read/cache-write/thought usage dimension, reporting diagnostics, and Pi runtime lineage through existing Session components without a Pi-specific duplicate view
Task-log model/session milestones are derived for mohist/pi and remain correctly ordered with operation log rows
No Pi model selector, provider credential form, Agent runtime selector, or Session-command control is added

docs/actions/pi.md and design/runtimes/pi.md implementation-gap sections mark the Workflow-direct PiRuntime/Action/Session reporting path implemented while leaving AgentJob, Session-command, and runtime-aware catalog/UI gaps explicit
Web tests cover Pi Inline Agent classification and Session/milestone rendering; npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass

Final repository verification passes: npm run typecheck -w packages/runner, npm test -w packages/runner, npm test, npm run typecheck -w packages/web, and npm run test:run -w packages/web; verification leaves no Git-visible changes
tasks.output: Pi-aware Workflow Session presentation and tests in packages/web, plus accurate remaining-gap footnotes in docs/actions/pi.md and design/runtimes/pi.md
tasks.notes: Final user-facing slice and closeout. Existing Session DTOs/components remain runtime-neutral; add only the classification/fixtures needed for Pi. Product/design bodies are target specs, so edit implementation-gap footnotes only.
